_instructions: Spec template for `kappmaker generate-screenshots --spec <file>`. Fill every empty field; keys starting with `_` are stripped before the spec is sent to the image model.

This is a proven BASELINE, not a rigid schema: you may add fields, restructure, or write a richer spec if it produces better images. Only the mechanical constraints are fixed: keep grid_layout as a 2×4 grid and exactly 8 entries in `screenshots` — the CLI slices the output image into 8 files on that assumption.
Keep each screen_visual_description to 2-3 sentences max — the image generator works best with focused descriptions.

Run `kappmaker generate-screenshots --print-prompt --prompt "<app description>" --style <1-8>` to get the style-specific visual direction (device framing, layout zones, typography rules) and bake it into the fields below.
When reference screenshots are passed via --input, the CLI prepends the instruction to use them as the app screens — describe marketing framing here, not the app UI pixels.
All 8 cells must share one brand system: same palette, same typography hierarchy, same lighting. Fill screenshots_overview.visual_consistency_rules accordingly.

grid_layout.arrangement: All 8 screenshots arranged in a single image as a 2×4 grid (2 rows, 4 columns). Each grid cell contains one complete vertical marketing screenshot.
